tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Best tools for a natural-language task: resolves the task to the capabilities it needs, returns products that expose them ranked by fit and AgentReady score, each with a reason. Optional requirements (api/mcp/self_serve/openapi/cli) filter candidates. Set discover:true to search the web and audit ne

tools.name: how_to
tools.description: BEFORE building something, call this: returns the CURRENT (date-stamped), cited, tool-aware way to do a task, so you build from today's best practice instead of training-cutoff memory. Composes live web research + the tool resolver + one synthesis pass into { approach, recommendedTools, steps, gotch

tools.name: find_tools_for_task
tools.description: Rank the software an agent should use for a task.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the registry by query + requirements (api/mcp/self_serve/openapi/cli).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Full registry profile (AgentReady Score, capabilities, sources).

tools.name: list_registry
tools.description: List the registry, highest AgentReady Score first.

tools.name: generate_agent_interfaces
tools.description: Make a product agent-native: from its OpenAPI, generate an MCP server (one tool per operation), a CLI, an llms.txt, and Claude Code/Codex/Cursor install snippets.

tools.name: research_company
tools.description: Grounded, cited answer about a company.

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.description: Real competitors and alternatives for a company, extracted from live research and returned as structured rows.

tools.name: compare_companies
tools.description: Structured side-by-side of companies across fields (description, products, categories, funding, technology).
